name: Midas mTBILL
oneLiner: mTBILL is Midas's NAV-accreting tokenized U.S. T-Bill fund via BlackRock IB01 ETF, FMA-regulated rails, with daily Ankura Trust NAV attestations.
collateral: Short-duration U.S. Treasury Bills (maturity <3 months) via BlackRock iShares $ Treasury Bond 0-1yr UCITS ETF (IB01); physical custody by Maerki Baumann & Co. AG (Switzerland); security ring-fencing by ATG Azimut Treuhandgesellschaft mbH; target return = 8-week U.S. T-Bill yield minus ~50 bps
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting token (not pegged to $1); price launched at ~$1.00 and appreciates continuously as T-bill yield accrues; permissioned mint/redeem at daily NAV via Midas smart contracts in USDC/USDT or fiat; NAV oracle published daily by Ankura Trust Company

proofOfReserves.provider: Ankura Trust Company (independent third-party; provides daily on-chain NAV attestations)

genius.licensingRegulator: EU Prospectus Regulation / MiFID financial-instrument context
genius.notes: mTBILL is treated as outside GENIUS payment-stablecoin tracking because it is a tokenized debt instrument/certificate rather than a payment stablecoin.

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (MiFID II financial instrument); EEA-passported; not available to U.S. or UK retail persons

reserves.name: BlackRock iShares $ Treasury Bond 0-1yr UCITS ETF (IB01)

mintAuthority.summary: mTBILL is Midas's tokenized T-Bill fund; new units are minted only by Midas's permissioned M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE when greenlisted users deposit through the Midas DepositVault, with NAV conversion settled off-chain at the Ankura Trust daily NAV.

controls.label: Midas issuance manager (M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE / DepositVault)
controls.evidence: Audited Midas vault architecture mints mTBILL via the permissioned M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE through the DepositVault against greenlisted deposits; conversion rate is set off-chain at the issuer's daily NAV and the mTBILL/vault contracts are upgradeable with pause/blacklist controls behind MidasAccessControl.

review.evidence: mTBILL is minted and redeemed exclusively through Midas's permissioned DepositVault/RedemptionVault contracts gated by MidasAccessControl roles (greenlist + M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE), with off-chain NAV pricing and upgradeable proxies; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists. On-chain owner/role holders not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the live on-chain MidasAccessControl role holders (mint operator, default admin) and proxy admin before raising confidence.
